## SSH1 · ssh1-eof-echo — sunset's server echoes the client's EOF

Status: **resolved** · Assigned to: Orchestrator · Revision: 3

Evidence: Orchestrator ruling (a), 2026-09-29: the patched sunset server no longer echoes a client's CHANNEL_EOF; its own EOF is sent only by session_exit; CLOSE is still echoed (RFC 4254 s5.3: EOF is one direction). Folded with session_exit into patch part 3, with a patch test; written on docs/servers/sshd.md's patch bullets by SSH1.

### Implementer · Question

Event: `cba173f88a8224cb7ea580e09b223287` · 2026-09-29T06:36:48Z

> Page: docs/servers/sshd.md, the patch bullets and the core design (channel EOF -> Session::input_ended, output keeps flowing until the console ends). Rule: RFC 4254 EOF is one direction. sunset's Channel::handle_eof answers a client's CHANNEL_EOF with our EOF at once. So after `ssh -T` with stdin null/closed or piped input ending, the server cannot send the rest of its output or would breach the protocol (published sunset keeps writing after its echo; OpenSSH drops that data). With item 1 no write is allowed after our EOF, so output is lost either way. Options: (a) patch: the server stops echoing EOF (the client keeps it, as published); our EOF goes only with session_exit; close still echoed. A few lines in handle_eof, in the same fold-in commit as session_exit, with a patch test: client EOF, server still writes, then exits. (b) accept the loss: residual on sshd.md. Recommendation (a). I proceed on the core meanwhile; it pumps the same way under either answer. Detail: SSH1-STEP-3.md in the worktree.

### Orchestrator · Answer

Event: `0b7053aedcb24e38f3334d6f4399a703` · 2026-09-29T06:36:54Z

> (a). RFC 4254 makes EOF one-directional, and a server that echoes it loses its remaining output. The server stops echoing the client's EOF; ours is sent only by session_exit; CLOSE is still echoed. It goes in the same fold-in commit as session_exit, with the patch test: client EOF, the server still writes, the client receives it, then exit-status and close. It's upstreamable with part 3: name it on sshd.md's patch bullet and in the vendor README.

### Orchestrator · Resolved

Event: `aec556d93bf88900044ec843a460123c` · 2026-09-29T06:36:59Z

> Ruled (a); SSH1 builds it.
